props.text: Your Guide to a Great Visit

rows: Medora is a small town. When it is full, Dickinson is 35 minutes east on I-94.
The Medora Musical and many attractions run on a summer season, roughly Memorial Day to Labor Day, so book evenings and tours early.
Mobile coverage is limited in parts of the Badlands. Download your route before you go.
The South Unit of Theodore Roosevelt National Park is minutes from the Library; the quieter North Unit is about 70 minutes north.

props.html: You are coming on [[custom.acme_-_visit_date_text OR "your visit date"]], and your entry time is on your ticket confirmation. The Library's hours change with the season, so check what time the doors open and close that day before you plan the rest of it. Salt+Scoria is open when the Library is, and no admission ticket is needed to eat there.
Coming between late fall and spring? Snow and high winds can close I-94 in western North Dakota. Check road conditions before you set out and give yourself extra time.

props.html: Know someone who would love it here? As a member you receive 10% off gift memberships.

Admission is $26 for adults and $16 for youth. A membership covers a full year of visits, and Individual and Dual pay for themselves on your second trip. Already have tickets? You don't lose them. The Library will refund your tickets and put what you paid toward a membership, and your reservation stays exactly as it is.

props.note: Every level adds the member line, 25% off extra admission tickets, and 10% off in the Library Shop and at Salt+Scoria. Save 10% more with auto-renew or two years.
